author: jracer15
body:
This is for players who are having trouble with yml, comment if you have any tips that may be common mistakes for yml walls maps!

Make sure there is NO tabs, only use spaces, if you have notepad ++ it will show you the errors by highlighting it in red, so I don't get archived for spamming the link check out ivy code's YAML resources to basically see examples(more than just walls), and ParaSpider's on how to package a map! There both in Map Making!

replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
I have to say, for my new map the YAML wasn't very hard at all. I just had one issue and it was very minor. Maybe it's different for walls I am not sure.

The thing I didn't know was, what were the variables when you were inputting the spawn co-ords. You need to use the X,Y,Z AND where your head is looking (found under the Z, last number on the right) then the 5th number is always 0.
